title: Someone talked about something you weren't interested in, but you kept listening
titleVi: Người nói về chủ đề bạn không quan tâm nhưng bạn vẫn lắng nghe
bullets: and explain how you feel about the experience

notes.label: Why kept listening
notes.text: politeness → he was so animated; patience

notes.label: Feel
notes.text: glad; glimpse of him; asked to help

segments.v: I want to talk about my grandfather. Last Tết I visited my grandparents in the countryside. My grandfather talked to me about bonsai trees for a long time. He told me how to cut the branches and take care of the trees. I was not interested in bonsai. It was boring for me. But I kept listening because he is my grandfather and I respect him. Also, he looked very happy when he talked about his trees. He had one tree for thirty years. After that, I felt happy because I talked with my grandfather for a long time. I don't like bonsai now but I learned that my grandfather is very patient. I think it was a good experience.

grammar.band6: Error: “He had one tree for thirty years” (He had had / He's had…).
grammar.band9: Past perfect continuous (he'd been shaping one tree for over thirty years), comparative with past perfect (more talkative than I'd seen him in years), and superlative + past perfect (the longest conversation I'd had with him).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 error: “He had one tree for thirty years” should be “He had had one tree for thirty years” (or “He's had…”). Band 9 shows how the reason for listening changed, which is exactly what the card asks.
